tasks.objective: Review source aggregates, stock-flow and applicable workbook overlap.

outputs: External aggregate/stock-flow QA, classified source/parser/model/cross-source discrepancies and optional workbook comparison

tasks.pi_validation: PI reviews material contradictions; W1 is complementary and does not block source QA.
tasks.completion: Every material discrepancy is classified with source evidence or an explicit processing gap.
exclusions: No artificial reconciliation, zero imputation or workbook-universe override.
resource_drivers: Cross-report counts and source review

tasks.objective: Audit measurement by regime, period, family and relevant dimensions.
inputs: Known source-unit frame/probabilities/strata and reviewed frozen evaluation rule
outputs: External stratified source audit, denominators, uncertainty and review coverage
technical_checks: Include apparent negatives/unprocessed units; separate targeted review; respect report/page/case clustering and selection weights.
tasks.pi_validation: PI conducts actual source-first audits and adjudication; optional specialist help is a separate concrete decision.
tasks.completion: Quality estimates/qualifications reflect actual sampled units and reviewer coverage.
exclusions: No fabricated independent reviewer or automatic second-person requirement.
resource_drivers: Sample/frame coverage and PI time

tasks.objective: Assess linkage, geography and model/version sensitivity.
inputs: Graph/geographic variants and retained model configuration history
outputs: External sensitivity/drift report with reviewed/unreviewed coverage and limitations
technical_checks: Pair/cluster consequences, bridge evaluations for model replacements and stable source-to-derivative identity.
tasks.pi_validation: PI assesses materially changing measures and any new production configuration.
tasks.completion: Claims identify configuration, uncertainty, review exposure and downstream sensitivities.
exclusions: No new model silently replacing qualified output.
resource_drivers: Variant builds and bridge reference effort
tasks.next_handoff: M10R-05 material issue and release-quality decision

tasks.objective: Classify material unresolved issues and prepare PI acceptance.
inputs: All unresolved issue and coverage registers
outputs: Source-safe release-quality statement and external issue disposition/PI acceptance record
technical_checks: Every material issue has type, provenance, scope and disposition; critical exceptions require explicit prospective policy.
tasks.pi_validation: PI decides acceptance/limitations and exact candidate scope; zero critical-error goals remain inherited.
tasks.completion: Actual acceptance or documented nonacceptance supports rights/release preparation.
exclusions: No numerical score or software pass as automatic acceptance.
resource_drivers: Issue backlog and PI decision time

tasks.objective: Assess release rights and privacy separately for each artifact class.
outputs: Source-safe rights/privacy/licence matrix and exact proposed public artifact allowlist
technical_checks: Separate code, PDF redistribution, workbook/derived data and model-output rights; exclude private operational records/reserved answers.
tasks.pi_validation: PI approves precise rights and public scope; code licence is not data permission.
tasks.completion: Releaseable artifacts and held artifacts are explicit before packaging.
exclusions: No raw-PDF licence inference, hidden evaluation answers or automatic public release.
resource_drivers: Rights evidence and disclosure review

tasks.objective: Package canonical Parquet/DuckDB and documented exports.
inputs: Accepted canonical build and schema/quality/provenance dictionaries
outputs: External immutable versioned Parquet/DuckDB, CSV/R/Stata/XLSX exports where justified and dictionary/quality joins
technical_checks: Canonical/export row/type/key/hash agreement, provenance/quality join closure and no-replace version publication.
tasks.pi_validation: PI verifies public scope matches allowlist and review-quality statement.
tasks.completion: Exports are documented derivatives of a fixed canonical candidate.
exclusions: No CSV/XLSX as canonical truth or overwritten prior release.
resource_drivers: Package/export volume and compatibility checks

tasks.objective: Create reproducible release metadata and stable identifiers.
outputs: External checksummed release bundle; source-safe changelog, citation, build manifest and approved DOI/stable IDs
technical_checks: Fresh retained-output rebuild/package checksum closure and source/config/schema version traceability.
tasks.pi_validation: PI approves repository/destination and publication action; no DOI is fabricated.
tasks.completion: Reproduction and citation identify exact package/version and limits.
exclusions: No unapproved archive upload or changed prior release bytes.
resource_drivers: Rebuild/archive volume and metadata review
tasks.next_handoff: M11R-04 exact public methods/scope release decision

tasks.objective: Publish only the PI-approved dataset scope with honest methods.
outputs: Public version, methods/coverage/limitations and AI/audit/review disclosures for approved artifacts
technical_checks: Final allowlist/checksums, licence/privacy exclusion and public review-coverage consistency.
tasks.pi_validation: PI explicitly releases exact version/scope; any unreviewed rows require supported quality claim.
tasks.completion: Publication reflects actual reviewed subset, source gaps and uncertainty.
exclusions: No blanket human-gold label, raw source release by accident or inferred approval.
resource_drivers: Publication checks and owner review
tasks.next_handoff: M12R-01 paper; M12R-02 handoff; M12R-03 maintenance

tasks.objective: Write the methods/data paper from measured reconstruction evidence.
inputs: Recorded performance, cost, audit/exposure design and limitations
outputs: Publication manuscript, measured methods/tables and reproducible examples
technical_checks: Claims trace to actual source-bound estimates and released artifacts; no unsupported superiority/novelty or causal claim.
tasks.pi_validation: PI authors/reviews interpretation and submission scope.
tasks.completion: Paper distinguishes extraction accuracy, review coverage and substantive inference.
exclusions: No invented endorsement, human-gold result or policy-effect proof.
resource_drivers: Writing, reproducible tables and publication review

tasks.objective: Prepare institutional handoff and record real feedback.
outputs: Handoff package, ownership/support notes and actual institutional feedback if contact authorized
technical_checks: Examples reproduce release and documentation links resolve; feedback provenance distinguishes received from proposed.
tasks.pi_validation: PI approves contacts and handoff; record actual Defensoría response.
tasks.completion: A usable handoff has stated ownership and limits; unperformed contact remains unperformed.
exclusions: No unsolicited outreach or invented institutional endorsement.
resource_drivers: Documentation/examples and authorized coordination

tasks.objective: Define monthly acquisition/update and bridge-evaluation SOP.
outputs: Source-safe monthly SOP, exception ownership, bridge-test and format-change alarm rules
technical_checks: Separate acquisition authority, old release retention, source/model/version change detection and scoped regression/bridge checks.
tasks.pi_validation: PI approves updates, new regimes/model configurations and human exception owner.
tasks.completion: Future routine operations have explicit scope/budgets/stops without stale retired-route gates.
exclusions: No unlimited standing authority or unapproved scheduled model/acquisition calls.
resource_drivers: New monthly source volume and model/format drift
tasks.next_handoff: M12R-04 separately authorized small update rehearsal

tasks.objective: Rehearse a small update and append-only corrections/backfills.

technical_checks: Source hash/version retention, resumability, correction lineage, bridge scores and old-package checksum invariance.
tasks.pi_validation: PI reviews actual update/source changes and separately decides publication.
tasks.completion: A measured small rehearsal demonstrates ownership and release-preserving corrections.
exclusions: No overwritten release, automatic update publication or unrun rehearsal claim.
resource_drivers: One bounded update, exception review and bridge evaluation
tasks.next_handoff: PI accepts maintenance ownership and future scoped updates

tasks.objective: Develop a separate research agenda from extractable measures.

exclusions: No reconstruction-only causal/policy/intergenerational effect claim.
